# client

```go
import "github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/protocol/client"
```

## type [ClientOpcode](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/protocol/client/init.go#L20>)

A Client Opcode represents the internal representations of all the defined client side operational codes that control the game flow\.

see definition here https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/docs/wiki/Protocol#frontend\.

```go
type ClientOpcode uint8
```

```go
const (
    DisconnectOpcode          ClientOpcode = 0x00
    UnknownOpcode             ClientOpcode = 0x01
    WhoAmIOpcode              ClientOpcode = 0x02
    AckMapOpcode              ClientOpcode = 0x03
    MovementOpcode            ClientOpcode = 0x0A
    ShootingOpcode            ClientOpcode = 0x14
    RequestOtherPlayersOpcode ClientOpcode = 0x1E
    RequestPlayerKDOpcode     ClientOpcode = 0x1F
)
```

### func [Detect](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/protocol/client/init.go#L122>)

```go
func Detect(opcode uint8) ClientOpcode
```

Detect converts from the an external byte into the internally used ServerOpcode type\.

Will return Unknown when there is no mapping for the given value\.
